product.olivetti-echos-43-color.summary: The mid-range Echos brought a colour screen to office applications.
product.olivetti-echos-43-color.history: In its October 1994 brochure, Olivetti positioned the Echos 43 Color between the monochrome 42 and the 44 Color for everyday business applications.
product.olivetti-echos-43-color.architec: Expansion cards could add connectivity. The brochure documents a VESA local video bus and room for two Type II PCMCIA cards or one Type III card.
product.olivetti-echos-43-color.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
